title: The Final Confession
author: Cyrus Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Ashgrove, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
